record.bible_text: My soul<WH05315> is weary<WH05354><WTH8804> of my life<WH02416>; I will leave<WH05800><WTH8799> my complaint<WH07879> upon myself; I will speak<WH01696><WTH8762> in the bitterness<WH04751> of my soul<WH05315>. <RF>weary...: or, cut off while I live<Rf>

Hast thou not poured me out<WH05413><WTH8686> as milk<WH02461>, and curdled<WH07087><WTH8686> me like cheese<WH01385>?
Thou hast clothed<WH03847><WTH8686> me with skin<WH05785> and flesh<WH01320>, and hast fenced<WH07753><WTH8787> me with bones<WH06106> and sinews<WH01517>. <RF>fenced: Heb. hedged<Rf>
Thou hast granted<WH06213><WTH8804> me life<WH02416> and favour<WH02617>, and thy visitation<WH06486> hath preserved<WH08104><WTH8804> my spirit<WH07307>.
And these <FI>things<Fi> hast thou hid<WH06845><WTH8804> in thine heart<WH03824>: I know<WH03045><WTH8804> that this <FI>is<Fi> with thee.<CM>
If I sin<WH02398><WTH8804>, then thou markest<WH08104><WTH8804> me, and thou wilt not acquit<WH05352><WTH8762> me from mine iniquity<WH05771>.

If I be wicked<WH07561><WTH8804>, woe<WH0480> unto me; and <FI>if<Fi> I be righteous<WH06663><WTH8804>, <FI>yet<Fi> will I not lift up<WH05375><WTH8799> my head<WH07218>. <FI>I am<Fi> full<WH07649> of confusion<WH07036>; therefore see<WH07202><WTH8798><WTH8676><WH07200><WTH8798> thou mine affliction<WH06040>;
For it increaseth<WH01342><WTH8799>. Thou huntest<WH06679><WTH8799> me as a fierce lion<WH07826>: and again<WH07725><WTH8799> thou shewest thyself marvellous<WH06381><WTH8691> upon me.

Thou renewest<WH02318><WTH8762> thy witnesses<WH05707> against me, and increasest<WH07235><WTH8686> thine indignation<WH03708> upon me<WH05978>; changes<WH02487> and war<WH06635> <FI>are<Fi> against me. <RF>witnesses: that is, plagues<Rf>
Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth<WH03318><WTH8689> out of the womb<WH07358>? Oh that I had given up the ghost<WH01478><WTH8799>, and no eye<WH05869> had seen<WH07200><WTH8799> me!
I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried<WH02986><WTH8714> from the womb<WH0990> to the grave<WH06913>.

<FI> Are<Fi> not my days<WH03117> few<WH04592>? cease<WH02308><WTH8798><WTH8675><WH02308><WTH8799> <FI>then, and<Fi> let me alone<WH07896><WTH8798><WTH8675><WH07896><WTH8799>, that I may take comfort<WH01082><WTH8686> a little<WH04592>,
Before I go<WH03212><WTH8799> <FI>whence<Fi> I shall not return<WH07725><WTH8799>, <FI>even<Fi> to the land<WH0776> of darkness<WH02822> and the shadow of death<WH06757>;
